en.title: Proof of Impure Justice
en.premise: A young man stands accused of murdering his father, a former judge. While the circumstantial evidence appears airtight, his lawyer notices a slight discrepancy in the testimonies, sparking a suspicion of a systematic cover-up orchestrated by the local community. Between a hidden record in a secondhand bookstore and a nameless cat wandering the streets, a cruel reality begins to emerge—one that the law is powerless to judge.

zh.title: 不纯的正义之证明
zh.premise: 一名青年被指控杀害了身为前法官的父亲。尽管情况证据看似无懈可击，但负责的律师从证词中细微的矛盾之处，直觉到事件背后潜藏着一场由当地社区精心策划的集体掩盖。一本隐藏在旧书店里的记录，以及一只在街头徘徊的无名之猫，将逐渐揭开法律无法审判的残酷真相。
